tagline.en: AlayaWorld — an interactive world model built on LTX-2.3, with camera control, spatial memory, and long-video rollout.
tagline.zh: AlayaWorld——构建于 LTX-2.3 的交互式世界模型，具备相机控制、空间记忆与长视频自回归生成。

en: AlayaWorld, from Alaya Lab, is an interactive world model that turns an image and text into a controllable video world. You can drive it with camera trajectories, and it supports autoregressive long-video generation so scenes can extend well beyond a short clip.

It is built as an extension of the LTX-2.3 video architecture, reusing its transformer, VAE, and a Gemma-based text connector, and adding action conditioning, a temporal-history encoder, and spatial memory backed by a Depth Anything 3 model for geometry. Inputs span image, text, and camera trajectory; outputs are video. Its released merged checkpoint is around 33.6 GB.
AlayaWorld is released with code and restricted weights, and it also draws on a gated Gemma-3 12B model as part of its stack.
zh: AlayaWorld 来自 Alaya Lab，是一个交互式世界模型，把图像与文本转化为可控的视频世界。你可以用相机轨迹来驱动它，并且它支持自回归的长视频生成，让场景可以远远超出短片段的长度。
它作为 LTX-2.3 视频架构的扩展构建，复用其 transformer、VAE 与基于 Gemma 的文本连接器，并加入动作条件、时序历史编码器，以及由 Depth Anything 3 模型提供几何支撑的空间记忆。输入涵盖图像、文本与相机轨迹，输出为视频。其发布的合并 checkpoint 约 33.6 GB。
AlayaWorld 以代码加受限权重的形式发布，其技术栈中还用到一个受访问限制的 Gemma-3 12B 模型。

whenToUse.en: Reach for AlayaWorld when you want a camera-controllable, image-and-text-driven world model that can roll out long videos with spatial memory across the scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个相机可控、由图像与文本驱动、并能带着跨场景空间记忆生成长视频的世界模型时，选择 AlayaWorld。

notFor.en: Heavyweight — its merged checkpoint is around 33.6 GB, weights are release-restricted, and its stack pulls in a gated Gemma-3 12B model you must have access to.
notFor.zh: 较为重量级——合并 checkpoint 约 33.6 GB，权重发布受限，且技术栈依赖一个需获授权的 Gemma-3 12B 模型。

Inputs span image, text, and camera trajectory
